projects.title: Course Project in Small-Image Classification
bullets: Trained a compact image classifier on public handwritten-symbol image collections as part of a supervised undergraduate course project.
Applied simple input transformations to handwritten-symbol images for the course project's study of small-image classification under input changes.

research.title: Supervised Research on Small-Image Classification
bullets: Loaded public small-image datasets from texture image collections as a student research assistant working under faculty supervision.
Summarized classification errors for supervised research examining small-image classification under input changes using public texture image collections.
